home.tasks.title: What do you need to solve?
home.tasks.lead: Start with the task. We fit the solution to it, not the reverse.
home.tasks.items.cleaning.title: Costly, inconsistent cleaning
home.tasks.items.cleaning.fit: Offices, shopping centers, warehouses, terminals, clinics: wherever floors are large, flat and hard.
home.tasks.items.cleaning.robot: Scrubs and sweeps floors along a set route, including at night and off-peak.
home.tasks.items.cleaning.people: Restrooms, desks, trash, corners and areas the robot can’t reach. Water and consumables.
home.tasks.items.cleaning.conditions: Flat hard flooring, clear aisles, space for charging and draining water.
home.tasks.items.cleaning.estimate: Get a preliminary estimate right away in the payback calculator. A detailed one follows a site assessment.
home.tasks.items.delivery.title: Not enough couriers
home.tasks.items.delivery.fit: Restaurants and stores, airports, campuses, hospital grounds and industrial sites.
home.tasks.items.delivery.robot: Carries the order in a locked compartment from pickup point to recipient at walking speed.
home.tasks.items.delivery.people: Pick and load the order, hand it to the recipient. An operator monitors the fleet remotely.
home.tasks.items.delivery.conditions: A route along sidewalks and driveways, a loading point with charging, the site owner’s consent.
home.tasks.items.delivery.estimate: Preliminary estimate once you describe the routes and order volume.
home.tasks.items.cargo.title: The warehouse can’t keep up
home.tasks.items.cargo.fit: Warehouses, distribution centers and production halls with constant internal transport.
home.tasks.items.cargo.robot: Moves pallets, carts and racks between zones, or follows a worker.
home.tasks.items.cargo.people: Loading and unloading, picking, quality control and exceptions.
home.tasks.items.cargo.conditions: Flat floor, wide enough aisles, agreed routes; integration with your warehouse system if the task needs it.
home.tasks.items.cargo.estimate: Preliminary estimate after a site assessment, based on routes, throughput and shifts.
home.tasks.items.custom.title: Something else
home.tasks.items.custom.text: Describe your site and task, and we’ll suggest a scenario and prepare a preliminary estimate.
home.process.title: How deployment works
home.process.lead: Six steps from assessment to SLA service. You see the numbers at every step.
home.process.steps.audit.title: Site assessment
home.process.steps.audit.text: We visit the site, review processes and numbers, and calculate payback.
home.process.steps.selection.title: Solution selection
home.process.steps.selection.text: Equipment from 2–5 manufacturers matched to the task, not tied to any one of them.
home.process.steps.purchase.title: Purchase support
home.process.steps.purchase.text: Full legal and logistics support for the deal, from contract to delivery on site. Installment plans and leasing from leading Russian banks.
home.process.steps.rollout.title: Turnkey deployment
home.process.steps.rollout.text: Delivery, setup, connection to Professional Robotics Platform and your systems, staff training and launch. If the vendor’s software lacks a feature, we build it.
home.process.steps.service.title: SLA service
home.process.steps.service.text: Our own service network across Russia. Full maintenance keeps your robot running for its entire service life.
home.process.steps.analytics.title: Analytics and scaling
home.process.steps.analytics.text: We review operating data, refine scenarios and scale up.

home.why.title: How we differ from a robot supplier.
home.why.main.title: Our own platform
home.why.main.text: We don’t resell vendor software. Professional Robotics Platform is our own Russian development: we connect robots of any brand and type and build the features your process needs.
home.why.main.foot: Data stored in Russia · data center in Skolkovo · How the platform works

home.why.cards.agents.text: They predict failures before downtime and reroute cleaning in real time.
home.why.cards.service.title: Service across Russia
home.why.cards.service.text: Our own network, working under SLA. We’re responsible for the robot working, not just for delivering it.
home.why.cards.brand.title: Not tied to any brand
